question: What is an embedding, and how does vector-search-based RAG use embeddings to find documents relevant to a question? Does this process retrain the answering model?
expanded_query: embedding vector search based rag embeddings find documents relevant question process retrain answering model

retrieved.title: How RAG Works
retrieved.passage:
How RAG Works
Find the relevant information, then give it to the AI with the question.
A question starts the search.
Illustrative animation, not a live AI call. Retrieval adds context; it does not retrain the model.

retrieved.title: Vector Databases & Vector Search
retrieved.passage:
Vector Databases & Vector Search
A vector database stores numerical representations of your text, called embeddings.
Similar meanings sit close together.
Vector search finds chunks near the question.
The AI reads those chunks to answer.
[Image description] Whiteboard meaning map inside a vector database. Saved document chunks form travel, food, and finance clusters. The question Where can I stay lands near travel chunks, including Hotels. Vector search selects nearby chunks and returns their text. Similar meanings sit close together.

retrieved.title: Context Moves “Bank” in Embedding Space
retrieved.passage:
Context Moves “Bank” in Embedding Space
[Image description] Three-dimensional embedding space with a base bank vector in orange. Adding river as context shifts it to a blue river bank vector near river. Adding money as context shifts it to a teal money bank vector near the base bank vector and money. Solid arrows are embedding vectors from a common origin; dashed arrows show changes from added context.
Illustrative 3D positions. + means adding context, not exact vector addition.

model_output.answer: Embeddings are numerical representations of text stored in a vector database, where similar meanings are located close together [class5:vector-databases-search-by-meaning:1]. Vector-search-based RAG uses these embeddings to find document chunks near the question by searching for chunks near the question [class5:vector-databases-search-by-meaning:1]. This process does not retrain the answering model [class5:building-a-tiny-rag-demo:1].
